phpExtension.reason: the PHP minors for which the release builds the PHP extension of the binding on each platform (binding GN-19d): an extension loads only into the PHP minor whose headers built it, so each supported minor that the requirement php >=8.4 of packages/php-ext/composer.json admits has an asset of its own. The job platform of .github/workflows/assets.yml sets up each with setup-php and runs make release-php-ext PHP=php after it, which extensionMinorErrors of scripts/repo/toolchains.mts compares with this list

llvm.reason: the major release of the LLVM whose libclang and clang the bindgen of ext-php-rs uses in make release-php-ext of packages/release.mk (binding GN-19d, GN-19h): clang-sys takes the libclang of the highest LLVM that it finds and bindgen asks the clang of PATH for its headers, so the two differ on a machine with several LLVM releases, and the ubuntu-26.04 runners hold LLVM 20, 21 and 22 with clang 21 as /usr/bin/clang. the ubuntu-26.04 images hold it and install-llvm-action of .github/workflows/assets.yml installs it on macOS; the recipe reads LLVM_ROOT, /usr/lib/llvm-<major> on Linux and LLVM_PATH of that action on macOS
llvm.removal: when the build of the PHP extension no longer runs bindgen, or a release of ext-php-rs no longer reads the libclang of the machine
